newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds rise on Bonte auction expectations.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds rise on Bonte auction expectations.

text.p: Argentine bonds were much higher late morning Tuesday on expectations of a very strong bid at this session's auction of $750 million in five-year Bonte Treasury bonds.
"There was talk that two local banks made some strong purchases ahead of the auction," said a trader at a local bank.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was up 3/8 at 93-1/4, while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 4 due 2002 was $0.50 higher at 115.75.
"The market is very strong," said another trader.
Market players told Reuters they expect a cut-off yield of between 8.75 percent and 9.0 percent at the Bonte auction, the results of which will be announced in the afternoon.
Traders said the privatization of Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) Tuesday in neighboring Brazil was also lifting sentiment in the region.
